Class LightGameState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am32.client.model.LightGameState
public class LightGameState extends Object
A lightweight client-side snapshot of the game state is represented.

    • isMandatorySelectionComplete

      public boolean isMandatorySelectionComplete(String nickname, int reqUpper, int reqLower, List<String> selUpper, List<String> selLower)
      The player's current selection is checked against mandatory character requirements. Character cards are mandatory up to the offer tile row limits, while building cards remain optional.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player performing the action
      reqUpper - the maximum number of cards allowed from the upper row
      reqLower - the maximum number of cards allowed from the lower row
      selUpper - the list of card IDs currently selected from the upper row
      selLower - the list of card IDs currently selected from the lower row
      Returns:
      true if all mandatory character cards are selected without exceeding row limits

    • isExtraAcquisitionValid

      public boolean isExtraAcquisitionValid(String nickname, String cardId)
      The specified card is checked for an extra acquisition action.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player
      cardId - the id of the selected card
      Returns:
      true if the card is in the upper row and affordable, false otherwise
